social_brawl_minor.title: A Disagreement Escalates
social_brawl_minor.description: Tensions boiled over. [initiator_name] and [target_name] came to blows over a petty dispute during morning forms.

effects.text: I severely beat [target_name] in a brawl.
I was brutally beaten by [initiator_name].

opt_restrain.text: Teach them a lesson, but hold back.

effects.text: I sparred with [target_name] to settle a dispute.
[initiator_name] bested me, but showed mercy.

sect_war_declaration.title: Declaration of War
sect_war_declaration.description: Diplomacy has failed. [initiator_sect_name] has officially declared a state of blood-feud upon [target_sect_name]!

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] declared war on [target_sect_name].

cultivation_breakthrough_attempt.title: On the Cusp of Enlightenment
cultivation_breakthrough_attempt.description: [initiator_name] senses their internal energy reaching a critical juncture. A breakthrough may be at hand — or a dangerous Qi Deviation.

opt_push_through.text: Push through the barrier. Risk everything for glory.

effects.text: I pushed my Qi to the limit. The outcome will reveal itself soon.

opt_meditate.text: Retreat into seclusion. Let the breakthrough come naturally.

effects.text: I entered seclusion to guide my Qi carefully.

cultivation_result_safe.title: A Steady Advance
cultivation_result_safe.description: [initiator_name] emerges from seclusion with a clearer mind and stronger meridians. The Dao rewards patience.

effects.text: My patient cultivation has borne fruit.

cultivation_result_risky.title: The Edge of the Abyss
cultivation_result_risky.description: [initiator_name]'s gamble with their Qi bears consequences. The channels burn...

effects.text: The breakthrough was agonizing, but I endured.

opt_fail.text: The Qi spirals out of control.

effects.text: I suffered a Qi Deviation. My foundation is damaged.

elder_teaches_technique.title: The Elder's Wisdom
elder_teaches_technique.description: Elder [initiator_name] watches a young disciple struggling with a difficult form and considers sharing a shortcut.

opt_teach.text: Share the technique. The sect's strength grows through its disciples.

effects.text: I took time to guide a struggling disciple today.
Elder [initiator_name] of [initiator_sect_name] passed down ancient wisdom.

opt_ignore.text: They must find their own path. Struggle forges iron.

effects.text: I watched a disciple struggle and said nothing. They must earn their knowledge.

disciple_requests_leave.title: A Request to Wander
disciple_requests_leave.description: [initiator_name] approaches you with a formal bow. They wish to travel the Jianghu and seek advanced martial knowledge before returning.

opt_grant_leave.text: Grant them leave. Go and return wiser.

effects.text: The Sect Master granted my request to wander. I will not waste this chance.

opt_deny_leave.text: Deny the request. The sect needs them here.

effects.text: My request to wander was denied. I must suppress my restlessness.

wanderer_returns.title: The Wanderer Returns
wanderer_returns.description: [initiator_name] has returned from their journey through the Jianghu, carrying stories of distant sects and new techniques.

effects.text: I have returned from my travels, changed by what I experienced.
[initiator_name] returned to [initiator_sect_name] after months of wandering the Jianghu.

internal_duel_challenge.title: A Challenge on the Training Ground
internal_duel_challenge.description: [initiator_name] publicly challenges a sect brother to a formal duel to prove their superiority. The training ground falls silent.

opt_accept_formally.text: Bow and accept. Victory brings prestige.

effects.text: A formal duel was held within [initiator_sect_name].
I issued a formal challenge to prove my superiority.

opt_refuse.text: Refuse with contempt. They are beneath notice.

effects.text: I refused to dignify their challenge. They are not worthy of my blade.

wandering_master_visits.title: A Grand Master Passes Through
wandering_master_visits.description: A renowned wandering master of the Jianghu has arrived at your sect's gates, seeking hospitality for the night. Their bearing speaks of tremendous cultivation.

opt_welcome_and_invite.text: Welcome them lavishly and invite them to exchange pointers.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] welcomed a renowned wandering master.

opt_turn_away.text: Turn them away politely. Strangers bring risks.

effects.text: I turned away the wandering master. My sect's secrets must be guarded.

wandering_master_departs.title: Parting Words
wandering_master_departs.description: The wandering master prepares to depart. Before leaving, they offer a parting gift for your hospitality — a technique scroll or a personal blessing.

effects.text: A wandering grandmaster bestowed a technique scroll upon [initiator_sect_name].

rival_spy_caught.title: A Wolf Among Sheep
rival_spy_caught.description: One of your disciples has uncovered a spy within the sect, a man who had been feeding information to a rival. The traitor now kneels before you.

opt_execute.text: Execute them publicly. Let the Jianghu know betrayal has a price.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] executed a captured spy from a rival sect.

opt_interrogate.text: Interrogate them for intelligence before deciding their fate.

effects.text: We wrung useful secrets from the spy before sentencing them.

opt_exile.text: Cripple their meridians and cast them out. A mercy they do not deserve.

effects.text: I crippled the spy's meridians and banished them. Let the Jianghu see my restraint.

tribute_demand.title: A Demand from Above
tribute_demand.description: An emissary from a hegemon sect arrives bearing demands: pay tribute of 300 silver, or face 'consequences'. Their sect's strength is undeniable.

opt_pay.text: Pay the tribute. Live to fight another day.

effects.text: I swallowed my pride and paid tribute. The sect endures.

opt_refuse.text: Refuse. The sect will not bow.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] refused to pay tribute, defying the hegemons.
I refused the tribute demand. We will face whatever comes.

resource_windfall.title: An Unexpected Discovery
resource_windfall.description: While expanding the sect's training grounds, your disciples unearthed a cache of long-buried spiritual herbs — a windfall from a forgotten age.

opt_distribute.text: Distribute the herbs among the disciples equally.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] discovered a cache of spiritual herbs and shared them with all disciples.

opt_keep.text: Secure the herbs in the sect vault for strategic use.

elder_challenges_authority.title: The Elder Speaks Out
elder_challenges_authority.description: Elder [initiator_name] has been openly criticizing your recent decisions in front of the disciples. The atmosphere in the sect is tense.

opt_confront.text: Confront them openly. Authority must be absolute.

effects.text: Tension between the Sect Master and an Elder erupted in [initiator_sect_name].
The Sect Master confronted me directly. My position is precarious.

opt_discuss_privately.text: Request a private audience. Let them air their grievances.

effects.text: The Sect Master listened to my concerns. A rare show of respect.

opt_demote.text: Demote them publicly. An example must be set.

effects.text: An Elder was publicly demoted in [initiator_sect_name].
I was publicly demoted for daring to speak my mind. Humiliation burns.

personal_existential_doubt.title: The Void Between Breaths
personal_existential_doubt.description: [initiator_name] finds themselves unable to enter meditation. For three days they have sat unmoving, confronting an emptiness they cannot name.

opt_seek_master.text: Seek guidance from a senior cultivator.

effects.text: I sought a senior's guidance through my spiritual crisis.

opt_endure.text: Endure alone. The Dao tests those it favors.

effects.text: I sat with the emptiness alone until it passed. The Dao tests those it favors.

new_year_banquet.title: The New Year Banquet
new_year_banquet.description: The New Year approaches. Tradition demands the sect hold a grand banquet. Disciples look forward to this with great anticipation.

opt_lavish.text: Hold a grand banquet. Spare no expense.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] celebrated the New Year with a magnificent banquet. Morale soars.
[initiator_sect_name] marked the New Year with a simple but heartfelt gathering.

opt_skip.text: Skip the festivities. Resources are scarce.

effects.text: I cancelled the New Year banquet. The disciples are unhappy.

tournament_invitation.title: An Invitation to the Grand Tournament
tournament_invitation.description: A sealed invitation arrives from a well-known regional sect, announcing the Great Martial Tournament of the Jianghu. First place commands legendary reputation.

opt_enter.text: Enter our best disciples. The Jianghu must know our strength.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] announced their participation in the Grand Tournament.

opt_decline.text: Decline. We are not yet ready to show our hand.

effects.text: I declined the tournament invitation. We will be ready when the time is right.

disciple_defects.title: Betrayal in the Night
disciple_defects.description: [initiator_name] has vanished in the night, taking stolen technique manuals with them. Rumor says they have joined a rival sect.

effects.text: A disciple defected from [initiator_sect_name], taking stolen scrolls.

opt_let_go.text: Let them go. Good riddance to faithless disciples.

effects.text: I let the traitor flee. Chasing them would cost more than they are worth.

stress_mental_strain.title: The Weight of Command
stress_mental_strain.description: [initiator_name] has been pushing themselves without rest. Their eyes are hollow, their movements erratic. Those closest to them speak of worry.

opt_take_rest.text: Enter brief seclusion. The sect can manage.

effects.text: I entered seclusion to restore my mind and spirit.

opt_push_through.text: Push through. Great leaders do not rest.

effects.text: I refused to rest. The fire in my chest will either forge me or consume me.

building_completed_celebration.title: A New Foundation
building_completed_celebration.description: The construction is complete. The disciples gather to admire the new structure. This milestone deserves acknowledgment.

opt_ceremony.text: Hold an opening ceremony. Toast the builders.

effects.text: [initiator_sect_name] completed a new building and celebrated its opening.

opt_skip.text: No ceremonies. Get back to training.

effects.text: The building is done. No celebration — there is still work to be done.
